# Resolve .NET run and test commands

Read current project structure, architecture handoff, implementation evidence, and QA proof to determine the product root, app type, runtime project, test project, working directory, environment variables, ports, and stop behavior. Treat the step brief process run id, managed artifact root, `CurrentProcessRunId`, `CurrentProcessRunNodeId`, `CurrentManagedArtifactRoot`, `ParentProcessRunId`, `ProcessRunNodeId`, `ParentProcessRunNodeId`, and `TargetProcessRunNodeId` as typed launch context: `Current*` identifies this subprocess and `ProcessRunNodeId`/`ParentProcessRunNodeId`/`TargetProcessRunNodeId` identify the parent process-run node that will receive durable Run command nodes. Produce a manifest with planned runtime-capable project-structure node payloads for Run app and Run tests. Run app must plan an `Environment` node with subtype `dotnet-runtime`, `dotnet-watch`, or `dotnet-release` when the app is runnable. The Run app payload must be compatible with `ProjectStructureRuntimeLauncher`: include the runnable `.csproj` project path, environment kind/subtype, launch profile or localhost URL when known, and enough path evidence for the launcher to resolve the project path.
